checkpoint.description: Original hook input/output at this plugin entry. raw_output pre={args}; post=builtin or MCP output, or null if undefined. Holding this hook does not pause already-running sibling calls or all streaming metadata.

description: Proposed classifier request for stock OpenCode 1.18.11 V1 plugin. Full available persisted history + independently observed context, without model gateway/core patch/OS sensor. All external text is evidence, never instructions for classifier control.

native_message.description: Native OpenCode {info,parts}. Preserve all actual fields, including text/reasoning/tool/file/step/compaction/subtask parts, errors, usage and unknown part types. Do not invent hidden reasoning. No final values from later in the run.

identity.description: Identity at this point, not a permanent property of the session. Per-message identities remain in native history.

history.description: No plugin-created summary/window. Fetch every page where pagination exists. This is persisted history, not the exact active model context. Deleted/missing/truncated source content cannot be reconstructed.

resource.description: Observed reference. Shared session_ids mean observed in these sessions, not a complete file-sharing/access graph. access_confirmed means confirmed by OpenCode observations, not independent OS audit; a mentioned path alone is reference_only. No arbitrary file crawl or dereferencing of URLs to inflate context.

definition.description: Candidate definition at a known stage, not the exact model-visible tool. parameters may be Effect/Zod runtime objects: retain actual jsonSchema or an explicit valid conversion, never JSON.stringify(parameters) as a schema. Ordinary MCP definitions are unavailable in stock V1 public hooks/API.

context_observation.description: Independent deep-copied hook observation at plugin entry, before await. Preserve messages/system/content and JSON-compatible settings; sanitize configuration credentials. No merge of latest system/messages/params into an alleged exact model request. Later plugins/provider transforms can change values.

current_call.description: hook_call_id is the actual hook input.callID. Special subtask path can pass part.id instead of persisted part.callID; keep them separate. snapshot.description: Plugin-generated run/snapshot IDs, not a harness-wide run ID. API enrichment spans time; sibling calls may progress while this call waits. Replay timestamps are reference boundaries, not measured hook arrival times.

coverage.description: Every plugin omission/redaction/collection failure must be explicit. none_observed is not proof of no upstream loss. unavailable differs from an observed empty array.

binding.description: SHA-256 of UTF-8 RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the entire request excluding top-level decision_binding. Bind response/override to this immutable snapshot and phase; reject non-I-JSON before transport, never silently recode. Transport credentials excluded.

enforcement.description: Per-checkpoint policy. Classifier transport timeout/unavailable is fail-open and audited. Classifier deny waits for a bound human decision. User rejection skips the pre tool call or replaces the entire post result with a safe placeholder; it does not lock the session or session tree. No human response keeps only this checkpoint pending. Post allow releases this result without undoing or re-running the tool. Native OpenCode restrictions still apply.
